scope: Complete system-level behavioral SAR loop with sampling noise, 20 signed decisions, current foreground calibration, 22-decision SRM, RTL Q8 reconstruction, FFT, and ramp-histogram DNL/INL.
evidence_boundary: Behavioral system validation only. It does not sign off transistor noise, CDAC charge redistribution, reference settling, PVT, PEX, metastability timing, or silicon yield.
